rows.grounds: first member of locative expression indicating body region
fused form: pradeśāt (region, ablative) + ūrdhve (above, indeclinable); sandhi fusion kept as one token
compound: brahma-viṣṇu-ardha-kāya (half-bodies of Brahma and Vishnu) + yuk (joined/possessing); describes upper bodily composition

items.question: What bodily composition characterizes the form above the waist region?
premises: The description specifies the region above the waist.
The upper portion is joined with half-bodies.
Those half-bodies belong to Brahma and Vishnu.
items.inference: Above the waist, the form is composed of the half-bodies of Brahma and Vishnu.
uncertainties: The exact iconographic arrangement of Brahma and Vishnu in the upper half is not specified.
items.plain_english: Above the waist region, however, the form is joined with the half-bodies of Brahma and Vishnu.
